⚠️ Failure Symptom & Factory Service Manual Root Cause

Symptom on machine: The upper-left Ice Master compartment freezes over with massive chunks of frost, stops dropping ice cubes, or flashes error 39C / 39E on the dispenser panel.

Verified technical root cause: Moisture intrusion into the upper ice room combined with failure of the internal ice mold heater or Auger Drain Tube clip on the Ice Master assembly.

🔧 Step-by-Step DIY Inspection & Replacement Checklist

  1. Press and hold the Ice Off button, thaw out the ice compartment gently with a steamer or hair dryer on low (never overheat the plastic liner), and remove the bucket.
  2. Unscrew the two Phillips screws on the DA97-15217D ice maker tray, unplug the wiring harness, install the revised DA97-15217D unit, and seal the outer perimeter seam of the ice box with food-grade silicone.

❓ Frequently Asked Questions (Ice Maker Frozen Solid / Error 39C / 39E)

Where is the Reset button on a Samsung DA97-15217D ice maker?
Pull the ice bucket out and look on the left or front side of the black/white ice maker module inside the top of the box—hold the small square blue 'Test' button for 5 seconds until it chimes.
